title: Fit a simple classifier
summary: A classifier chooses a group label. fit lets the model learn from examples. A decision tree splits inputs using learned thresholds.
introduction: A classifier chooses a group label. fit lets the model learn from examples. A decision tree splits inputs using learned thresholds. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A classifier chooses a group label. fit lets the model learn from examples. A decision tree splits inputs using learned thresholds.

blocks.code:
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
X = [[1], [2], [8], [9]]
y = [0, 0, 1, 1]
model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=1, random_state=0)
model.fit(X, y)
print(model.predict([[1.5], [8.5]]).tolist())
blocks.title: Fit a simple classifier

blocks.text: The predictions are [0, 1]. The shallow tree separates the low and high numbers in this toy dataset.

blocks.text: A toy split does not prove a model will work on a real-world problem.
